recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Only revisit if OO opens a new current-cycle issue to alter Observation component versus hasMember/derivedFrom examples.
issue_request: FHIR-7148 was a Published OO change request with Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU1. It asked to clarify an unclear Observation note about Apgar having both a value and related observations, and the accepted resolution was to clarify the Notes section and point to the existing Glasgow example rather than the confusing Apgar wording.
initial_application: The issue was applied in 2015 by commits d4505c43ef, 65be721ff9, and 5ed5b573f8, which rewrote Observation notes/introduction text around grouping, related observations, components, and Glasgow/Apgar examples. Those commits explicitly mention #7148 and added the clarified grouping discussion before later source refactors.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the checked Observation narrative, StructureDefinition source, and examples are in the current build. Later Observation refactors replaced the old Observation.related model with component, hasMember, and derivedFrom guidance. Current source no longer contains the obsolete "Apgar store" wording and now distinguishes Apgar-style component results from independent observations linked with hasMember or derivedFrom. Focused community searches found no FHIR-7148 Zulip or Confluence records and no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Observation Notes and examples already convey the clarified distinction requested by the tracker under the modern Observation model, so adding the old Glasgow prose would be redundant and could drift from current component/hasMember/derivedFrom guidance.

related_jiras.note: The historical 2015 Observation commits mention #7148 and #7161 together; FHIR-7161 was not decided because the seed could be audited independently and no separate bounded decision was required.
